phase: P2 — make the live inputs sustainable from now on

found: data/damodaran/archives/ — dated provider files (ctryprem{00..24}) + receipt.json with per-file sha256 (fetched 2026-08-06)
data/admin/nasdaq_giw_sox/history/constituents.json — snapshot history pattern (source_date basis, bounded persistence)
data/computed/*_history.json — append-style history arrays (e.g. fenok_flow_proxies_history.json, fenok_occ_options_volume_history.json)
existing_repo_conventions_checked.followed: rim-index/archive/ per-lane JSON array files under data/computed/rim-index/archive/, matching the computed/*_history.json array convention with provenance fields like the damodaran receipt

append_only_rules.dedup: stable key = kind | source_as_of | derived_aggregate_hash, where derived_aggregate_hash covers ONLY the economic projection of the observation. Collection timestamps and whole-file hashes are recorded on the vintage as provenance and are excluded from the key.
append_only_rules.revision: a new source_as_of or a new derived hash is a NEW vintage with its own vintage_id and collected_at; never a silent replacement

forecast.what_is_archived: index-relevant FY1/FY2/FY3 consensus path (forecast_grid_v1 earnings_proxy per period) for SPX and NDX

payout.what_is_archived: both payout routes (derived.payout_ratio route A, derived.legacy_payout_ratio_qa route B) plus the underlying index yield observations (slickcharts sp500-yield / nasdaq100-yield)

erp.what_is_archived: the exact live ERP source class — Damodaran country-premium file (data/damodaran/erp.json, ctrypremApr26.xlsx / ERPs by country), US equity risk premium

reader_policy.statement: Current live readers (build-rim-index.mjs and downstream) keep resolving the latest valid vintage from the live files with unchanged field semantics. The archive is a history estate for future PIT validation; it is not the reader.

proves: refresh 1 appends one vintage per lane
refresh 2 with the identical observation dedupes to the existing vintage_id (vintage 1 survives)
a genuinely new observation appends vintage 2 and BOTH vintages survive
archive records carry the live-semantic fields (fy1/fy2/fy3, payout A/B, yield observation, ERP value) and both hashes

prohibitions: no silent overwrite of an existing vintage
no dedup by anything weaker than the stable key
no changing live reader field semantics to fit the archive

handler_correction_2026_08_08.found_by: scoped code review after the verdict was issued
handler_correction_2026_08_08.defect: The payout lane hashed the SlickCharts scrape timestamp (yield_observation.updated) and the whole-file yield hash into derived_aggregate_hash, and used that same scrape timestamp as source_as_of. Both feed the dedup key, so every re-scrape that changed nothing but its own timestamp minted a new 'revision' with economically identical payout routes. The archive would have appended forever and deduplicated nothing.
handler_correction_2026_08_08.why_the_original_tests_missed_it: Tests 1-3 re-ran against the same on-disk yield file, so the timestamp never varied and the key never moved. The defect was invisible to a test that cannot change the source.
repair: derived_aggregate_hash for the payout lane now hashes only {index, payout_route_a, payout_route_b, yield_pct}

source_as_of is null with an explicit source_as_of_kind, because the provider publishes no source date for the index yield observation; naming a scrape timestamp as an economic as-of was the same error in a second place
raw_source_hash records both yield file digests in full; it previously concatenated the SPX digest with a 32-char truncation of the NDX digest, which no rule could reproduce
a partial observation (a missing payout route, or an index with no forecast_grid_v1 periods) now fails the lane instead of being archived as a legitimate vintage
appendVintage writes through a temp file and renames, so a concurrent refresh cannot tear the history array
new_regression_tests: test 5: two yield fixtures differing ONLY in their scrape timestamp must produce the same economic hash, the same stable key, and must dedup to a single vintage
test 6: a genuine payout move must still append, proving the dedup is not over-collapsing
handler_correction_2026_08_08.old_key_demonstrated_broken: Reconstructing the pre-fix key material over the two fixtures gives b67fd3020fe51e3d... and 41972373b902bf4a... — different keys for the same economics.
handler_correction_2026_08_08.archive_reseeded: The three vintages seeded earlier on 2026-08-08 were discarded and re-seeded under the corrected contract, so the archive's first vintage carries a valid key. Nothing predating 2026-08-08 existed to lose; the append-only guarantee runs forward from this corrected starting point.
